items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: Rod Brown, that was a big man.

ctx.x: It was beautiful. They brought all big attractions in Club Desire. You remember when the Fat Davin new first mate B? He was strong, going big. Well, they kept him at Club Desire. Rod Brown, that was a big man. Remember that big number that stands out today? What's that? That big number is Good Rockin' Tonight.
